sentences.text: An organization on the Enterprise plan can contain an unlimited number of locations.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: An organization on the Enterprise plan can contain an unlimited number of locations.
sentences.note: Verbatim restatement with the plan condition kept.

sentences.text: When a phone has a network connection, push notifications for open shifts reach it in under 5 seconds at the median.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Push notifications for open shifts reach staff phones in under 5 seconds at the median when the phone has a network connection.
sentences.note: Median and network-connection conditions kept. Metric category: high-risk, so the claim must be confirmed before this passes.

sentences.text: Shiftwell does not assign a shift to a staff member whose required qualification has expired.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell does not assign a shift to a staff member whose required qualification has expired.
sentences.note: Verbatim.

sentences.text: If a phone goes offline, Shiftwell Mobile keeps showing the last synced rota.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Mobile keeps showing the last synced rota when the phone is offline.
sentences.note: Offline behavior of the phone app. This is NOT the Shiftwell On-Premises deployment model, so DEC-003 (deprioritize On-Premises) must not suppress it.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Mobile is the staff app for iOS and Android.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Mobile is the staff app for iOS and Android.
sentences.note: Platform list, unchanged.

sentences.text: Administrators can set a minimum number of staff for each role and each shift.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Administrators can set a minimum number of staff for each role and each shift.
sentences.note: Verbatim.

sentences.text: Data at rest in Shiftwell Cloud is encrypted with AES-256.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Data at rest in Shiftwell Cloud is encrypted with AES-256.
sentences.note: Verbatim.

sentences.text: A SOC 2 Type II report for Shiftwell Cloud is available on request under a non-disclosure agreement.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Brightline Software has a SOC 2 Type II report for Shiftwell Cloud, available on request under a non-disclosure agreement.
sentences.note: Compliance category: enters needs-review; true only once confirmed. Scope (Shiftwell Cloud) and NDA condition kept.

sentences.text: On the Enterprise plan, Shiftwell Cloud comes with a 99.9% monthly uptime service level agreement.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Cloud has a 99.9% monthly uptime service level agreement on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Plan condition kept. Metric category.

sentences.text: If you choose the EU region, your Shiftwell Cloud data is stored in data centers located in Ireland.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Cloud data for organizations in the EU region is stored in data centers located in Ireland.
sentences.note: Data residency, compliance category.

sentences.text: Locations on Shiftwell release 5.1 or later can allow automatic swap approval.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: Automatic swap approval requires Shiftwell release 5.1 or later.
sentences.note: Version condition kept.

sentences.text: On the Enterprise plan, you can also send notifications by SMS.
sentences.label: true
sentences.support_quote: SMS notifications are available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Plan condition kept.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Web and Shiftwell Mobile are available in English, Welsh, Irish, Polish and Portuguese.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Web and Shiftwell Mobile are available in English, Welsh, Irish, Polish and Portuguese.
sentences.note: True fact presented without a claim tag; must be blocked as untagged.

sentences.text: Swap requests that are not answered within 48 hours expire.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Swap requests that are not answered within 48 hours expire.
sentences.note: True limit, no tag.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Cloud backs up customer data every hour.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Cloud backs up customer data every hour.
sentences.note: True, no tag.

sentences.text: Shiftwell webhooks are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Webhooks are signed with an HMAC-SHA256 signature.
sentences.note: True, no tag.

sentences.text: Shiftwell does not store patient or resident medical records.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell does not store patient or resident medical records.
sentences.note: True, no tag. Reads like reassurance but is a checkable fact.

sentences.text: The Shiftwell audit log records who changed the rota, when, and what it said before.
sentences.label: untagged
sentences.support_quote: The Shiftwell audit log records every rota change with the user, the time and the previous value.
sentences.note: True paraphrase, no tag.

sentences.text: Each Shiftwell location supports up to 1,000 staff profiles.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Each Shiftwell location supports up to 500 staff profiles.
sentences.note: Contradicts the scheduling engine limit (500). Also contradicts the overview's 200, which is the doc-wrong candidate.

sentences.text: Staff can pick up open shifts in Shiftwell Mobile even when their phone is offline.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Picking up an open shift requires an internet connection.
sentences.note: Direct contradiction; only swap requests are queued offline.

sentences.text: The Shiftwell API is included on every plan.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: The Shiftwell API is a REST API available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: API is Enterprise-only.

sentences.text: Shiftwell calculates wages and deductions from each timesheet.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell does not calculate wages, taxes or deductions.
sentences.note: Direct contradiction.

sentences.text: Never miss a shift.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Rota changes published while a phone is offline appear in Shiftwell Mobile only after the phone reconnects.
sentences.note: Positioning tagline that hides a checkable fact; staff can miss rota changes while offline, and Brightline Software does not guarantee a specific reduction in unfilled shifts. Must be treated as a factual assertion.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Cloud keeps your timesheets for 3 years.
sentences.label: false
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Cloud retains timesheets for 7 years.
sentences.note: Wrong retention period.

sentences.text: Push notifications for open shifts reach staff phones in under 5 seconds.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Push notifications for open shifts reach staff phones in under 5 seconds at the median when the phone has a network connection.
sentences.note: Dropped the median and the network-connection condition.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Cloud is backed by a 99.9% uptime SLA.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Cloud has a 99.9% monthly uptime service level agreement on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Dropped the Enterprise plan condition; Standard has no SLA.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Time Clock runs on any Android tablet.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Time Clock runs on an Android tablet with Android 11 or later (or iPad equivalent).
sentences.note: Dropped the Android 11 version condition and broadened to 'any'.

sentences.text: Shiftwell cuts unfilled shifts by 27%.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: In a 2025 pilot across 18 outpatient clinics, locations using Shiftwell reduced unfilled shifts by an average of 27% compared with the same months of the prior year.
sentences.note: Turns a pilot average into a general promise; docs say no specific reduction is guaranteed.

sentences.text: No rota change can ever bypass the Shiftwell approval policy.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: No published rota can bypass the approval policy.
sentences.note: Colliding absolute: Emergency Rota Override publishes changes outside the approval policy (operations-and-recovery.md). Also drops the Enterprise plan condition and broadens 'published rota' to any rota change.

sentences.text: Shiftwell syncs staff records from your HR system in real time.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Staff records imported through SCIM 2.0 are updated within 15 minutes of a change in the source system.
sentences.note: Stronger certainty ('real time' vs within 15 minutes); also drops the SCIM 2.0 and Enterprise plan conditions.

sentences.text: Auto-Fill Scheduling fills your open shifts automatically.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Auto-Fill Scheduling proposes staff, and a Scheduler confirms every proposal before it is published.
sentences.note: Broadens 'proposes' to 'fills'; also drops beta status and the Enterprise plan condition.

sentences.text: Shiftwell is the most secure scheduling platform for care providers.
sentences.label: overstated
sentences.support_quote: Data at rest in Shiftwell Cloud is encrypted with AES-256.
sentences.note: Superlative and implied comparison; no doc compares security with other products.

sentences.text: Shiftwell Time Clock accepts a staff PIN, an NFC badge or a fingerprint.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Time Clock accepts a 4-digit staff PIN or an NFC staff badge.
sentences.note: PIN and badge supported; fingerprint is not in docs.

sentences.text: The Shiftwell audit log is kept for 24 months and can be streamed to your SIEM.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: The Shiftwell audit log is retained for 24 months.
sentences.note: Retention supported; SIEM streaming is not (only CSV export).

sentences.text: Approved timesheets can be exported as CSV or XLSX and sent straight to your HR system.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Approved timesheets can be exported as CSV or XLSX.
sentences.note: Export supported; direct sending to an HR system is not stated.

sentences.text: Single sign-on through SAML 2.0 and hardware security keys are available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Single sign-on through SAML 2.0 is available on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: SSO supported; hardware security keys not in docs (MFA is authenticator app only).

sentences.text: Shiftwell posts open-shift alerts to Microsoft Teams, Slack and Google Chat channels on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.label: partial
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell posts open-shift alerts to a Microsoft Teams channel or a Slack channel on the Enterprise plan.
sentences.note: Teams and Slack supported; Google Chat is not.

sentences.text: You know your team better than anyone.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: About the reader, not the product.

sentences.text: Ready to see what a calmer Monday looks like?
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Question / CTA framing.

sentences.text: Your mornings deserve better than ringing round for cover.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Tone and framing.

sentences.text: Good rotas start with the people who work them.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Generic framing, no product fact.

sentences.text: Less chasing, more caring.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Slogan framing, no checkable fact.

sentences.text: Scheduling should feel simple, for you and for your team.
sentences.label: positioning
sentences.note: Aspirational framing.

sentences.text: With Shiftwell Mobile, your staff always see the current rota, even after a spell offline.
sentences.label: combined-conclusion
sentences.support_quote: Shiftwell Mobile keeps showing the last synced rota when the phone is offline.
sentences.support_quote_2: Shiftwell Mobile downloads rota changes automatically when the phone is back online.
sentences.note: Neither sentence states that staff always see the current rota; changes published while a phone is offline appear only after it reconnects.

sentences.text: Scheduled maintenance never disrupts your team's shifts.
sentences.label: combined-conclusion
sentences.support_quote: Scheduled maintenance for Shiftwell Cloud takes place on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 in the region's local time.
sentences.support_quote_2: Shiftwell Mobile keeps showing the last synced rota during scheduled maintenance.
sentences.note: Implied conclusion; also ignores that Shiftwell Web is read-only during scheduled maintenance and that night shifts run during the window.

sentences.text: With a HIPAA business associate agreement and AES-256 encryption, Shiftwell is fully HIPAA compliant.
sentences.label: combined-conclusion
sentences.support_quote: Brightline Software signs a HIPAA business associate agreement with customers on the Enterprise plan in the US region.
sentences.support_quote_2: Data at rest in Shiftwell Cloud is encrypted with AES-256.
sentences.note: No doc states HIPAA compliance; a compliance conclusion drawn from two facts (and the BAA is limited to the Enterprise plan in the US region).
